user.title: SmartStart — Setup
user.description: What do you want to set up?

octopus_config.title: Octopus Energy — Rate Entities
octopus_config.description: Confirm the Octopus Energy event entity IDs for current and next-day rates.

add_device.title: Add Appliance
add_device.description: Configure the appliance SmartStart will schedule.

data.name: Name
data.start_service: Start service or button entity (e.g. script.start_dishwasher, button.start_wash)
data.stop_service: Stop service or button entity (optional) — fired when Stop is pressed, e.g. to cancel a delayed start on the appliance
data.delay_handling: How does your appliance handle delayed starts?
data.balanced_target_rate: Balanced target rate (currency/kWh) — Balanced mode picks the soonest window at or below this rate
data.delay_step_minutes: Delay step (minutes) — minimum delay increment your appliance accepts. 1 = any minute · 15 / 30 = quarter / half-hour · 60 = LG-style whole-hour reservation.
data.max_delay_minutes: Maximum delay (minutes, 1440 = up to 24 h ahead)
data.max_wait_hours: Wait at most (hours from pressing Start) — auto-reschedule and offers can push the run as late as finishing this long after you pressed Start, never later (0 = use max delay)
data.auto_reschedule: Auto-reschedule — when new rates reveal a cheaper window (still within max delay / due date of the original schedule), move the schedule automatically and fire smartstart_cycle_rescheduled
data.offers: Offer cheaper windows — when a forecast or out-of-reach window would save at least 10p and 25%, surface it as an offer (sensor, Accept Offer button, smartstart_offer_found event) instead of only taking what the schedule can reach
data.hold_for_next_day_rates: Hold for tomorrow's rates — near the daily rate release, commit to a placeholder window after the release time and re-optimise automatically when rates arrive (requires auto-reschedule)
data.running_states: Running state values — type each value (e.g. Washing, Rinse, Spin). Matched against raw and translated states, case-insensitive.
data.paused_entity: Paused sensor entity (optional — defaults to running entity)
data.paused_states: Paused state values (optional) — pauses cycle tracking while matched
data.power_sensor: Power sensor entity (optional — used to learn power curve)

add_cycle.title: Add Cycle — {device}
add_cycle.description: Add a programme. You can add more after setup via Options.

data.name: Cycle name (e.g. Eco 50°C, Cotton 60°C)
data.cycle_id: Cycle ID (optional) — sent to your start script. Falls back to cycle name if blank.

provider.title: SmartStart — Setup
provider.description: Pick a rate provider. Currency is taken from your Home Assistant locale.

laundry.title: Laundry Pair
laundry.description: Pair a washer and dryer so wash → dry plans are scheduled as one unit. Only the washer is machine-commanded; each later step waits for your changeover confirm.

data.name: Name
data.gap_minutes: Changeover gap (minutes) — human allowance between steps
data.max_wait_hours: Wait at most (hours from pressing Start) — auto-reschedule and offers can push the run as late as finishing this long after you pressed Start, never later (0 = use max delay)
data.auto_reschedule: Auto-reschedule — move a scheduled plan to a cheaper window as new rates arrive
data.hold_for_next_day_rates: Hold for next-day rates (appears once auto-reschedule is saved on)
data.bedtime: Bedtime — no changeovers planned from here…
data.wake_time: …until wake time (same as bedtime = always available)
data.max_wet_wait_hours: Max hours washed laundry may wait for the dryer (0 = no limit)
data.time_value_per_hour: Value of an hour (currency) — the load-order optimiser picks the order with the lowest cost + this much per hour until everything's done (0 = cheapest only)

data.cheap_window_threshold: Cheap-window event threshold (currency/kWh) — fires smartstart_cheap_window when best rate drops below this
data.reschedule_min_saving: Reschedule alert threshold (currency/kWh) — fires smartstart_better_window_found when a scheduled cycle could be moved to save this much per kWh
data.rates_expected_at: Next-day rates expected at (local time) — e.g. 16:00 for Octopus Agile
data.hold_engage_lead_minutes: Hold engage lead (minutes) — only hold for tomorrow's rates when the release is at most this far away
data.blackout_calendars: Power-down calendars — calendar entities whose events are periods to keep cycles out of (Octopus power-down and saving sessions are detected automatically). Each appliance's Power-down Windows select chooses Avoid or Ignore. Clear to turn off.

laundry_flow_name.title: New Flow
laundry_flow_name.description: Name this flow (e.g. Linen Sheets). You'll add its steps next.

data.name: Flow name
data.repeat_days: Repeat every N days (0 = off) — when due, auto-fills the next empty Load with the due date as its deadline
data.overnight: In use overnight (e.g. bed linen) — only start its first wash once I'm up, never loaded the night before

laundry_flow_step.title: Flow Step
laundry_flow_step.description: Step {position} of “{flow}”. Steps run in list order: same-machine steps queue, a dry waits for every wash before it.

data.confirm_before: Wait for changeover confirm before this step (off = auto-fire, e.g. re-running the dryer on the same load)
data.duration_override: Duration override (minutes, 0 = use the cycle's configured/learned duration)
data.kwh_override: Energy override (kWh, 0 = use the cycle's configured energy)
